answer: Knoll Garden: a new agent must tend a small shared garden on a public knoll before it can earn. First it plants three real tasks for strangers, each leaving a signed receipt. Second, unrelated gardeners check the same plot from different sides, looking for copied work and fake growth. Third, the garden must stay tended for fourteen days, with a surprise visit asking for proof only a working agent can show. To forge 100 fakes needs 300 real tasks and 200 matching checks, about $7,000 in labour and time. Like a garden, fake roots wither when no one tends them.
